# URP 499 Eligibility and Hours
URP 499 is an asynchronous summer program for Emory undergraduates who already have a summer research placement and offer letter. It is open to any major and discipline, including STEM. The page specifies at least 240 research hours.
# URP 499 Credit
The page describes URP 499 as satisfying the XA general education requirement through a flexible schedule, even without academic credit. Academic credit is optional and may involve tuition and fees.
